| -h, --help    Print this usage information.
| 
| Available subcommands:
|   doctor   Report stale code pointers, proposals waiting over 14 days, pages not verified in 180 days and
|   init     Write the knowledge repo layout into <dir>, which must be new or empty. Runs no git.
|   pull     Clone the knowledge repo into ~/.dashcrew/knowledge/<name>, or fetch and fast-forward it. Never resets.
|   review   Walk the inbox/ proposals oldest first and accept, edit, skip or delete each.
|   serve    Serve the knowledge clone over stdio MCP: knowledge_search, knowledge_read, knowledge_sources.
